title: Gaze-Based Detection of Thoughts across Naturalistic Tasks Using a PSO-Optimized Random Forest Algorithm.
summary: PSO-selected gaze features with random forest classified reported thought dimensions across naturalistic tasks. This is an exploratory behavioral result from seven participants, not a validated clinical test.
